paper.title: Fine-Grained Soybean Variety Recognition Using Swin Transformer with Differential Attention and Dynamic Channel Aggregation

evidence.paraphrase: The title identifies fine-grained soybean variety recognition, not vehicle make recognition.
The study classifies 25 soybean varieties from standardized cropped soybean seed images after YOLO-based localization and manual verification.
Local feature reuse and differential attention improve soybean classification, but the abstract does not study semantic vehicle parts, missing vehicle views, or occlusion robustness.

reviews.rationale: The paper is about fine-grained soybean seed classification and therefore falls outside the vehicle make recognition population and outcome. Its local-feature and attention terminology creates partial lexical overlap, but it does not provide the semantic vehicle-part or occlusion evidence required by the assigned group.
